 With Dallas Mavericks head coach Dusty May getting his first win in the 121-105 victory over the Indiana Pacers, the team is now dealing with injuries to two key players. As Mavericks star Cooper Flagg is battling a shoulder sprain, the status has now been revealed for Kyrie Irving and his listing for Saturday's contest against the San Antonio Spurs.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement According to NBA insider Marc Stein, Dallas is "expected" to list Irving as "questionable" for the aforementioned game against the Spurs on Saturday. In regards to the injury listed with Irving, it will be due to the player's "ongoing left knee injury management" as the game is second game of a back-to-back.
 "The Mavericks, I'm told, are expected to list Kyrie Irving as questionable for tonight's home opener as part of Irving's ongoing left knee injury management on Dallas' first back-to-back of the season," Stein wrote on X, formerly Twitter. "Dallas is already without Cooper Flagg due to a mild left shoulder sprain."
 Watch sports LIVE with fuboTV (free trial) 
 Through two games for Dallas after coming back from a torn ACL, Irving has averaged 19.5 points, 2.5 assists, and 2.5 rebounds per game while shooting 58.3 percent from the field and 42.9 percent from three-point range.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement More information on Mavericks' Cooper Flagg and his shoulder injury 
 While Irving's injury issue doesn't appear to be particularly serious, as it's management of the 34-year-old in back-to-backs, the situation with Flagg is one that will concern some fans. After a hard fall in the win over the Pacers, Flagg will miss Saturday's clash with the Spurs, as the team announced that he "will be re-evaluated next week." 
 "The Dallas Mavericks announced today that Cooper Flagg underwent an MRI that revealed a mild left shoulder sprain," the team's PR account wrote Saturday afternoon on X. "Flagg will be listed as out for tonight's game against San Antonio and will be re-evaluated next week. Further updates will be provided as appropriate."
 Click Here to Subscribe At any rate, it remains to be seen what Irvin's status will look like for Saturday night and when Flagg will return, as the next game is a road game against the Miami Heat on Monday.
